notes.title: Nordic Game Jam 2025
notes.content:
We are excited to announce we will be attending the showcase in [url=https://nordicgamejam.com/]Nordic Game Jam[/url] and participating in the game jam thereafter. Come say hi, we don't bite and we will be giving out some fun knick knacks alongside showing our latest demo :D
